entry.name: translate
entry.description: The translate object converts from any of the fixed or relative Max time values to any other fixed or relative time value.

arguments.name: input-format
arguments.description: The first argument sets the input format to expect. These arguments are a shortcut for setting the attributes of this object which do the same thing. Time can be specified in any of theused in Max.

arguments.name: output-format
arguments.description: The second argument sets the format to output. These arguments are a shortcut for setting the attributes of this object which do the same thing. Time can be specified in any of theused in Max.

attributes.name: listmode
attributes.digest: Translate Lists
attributes.description: Whenis enabled, incoming lists are treated as a series of single values to translate one-by-one, producing a list of translated time values. However, list conversion only happens when both the input and output time formats are single-valued. Whenis disabled or the input or output time formats are multi-valued, an input list will be treated as describing a single time value with multiple elements.

attributes.name: mode
attributes.digest: Time value mode
attributes.description: Sets the mode for time values. Theobject can output time values in eitherrelative to the system start value of 1.1.0 or, where a value of 1.1.0 would indicate one bar, one beat, and no units (2400 ticks at 4/4 in the default resolution).Note: this attribute may not apply, depending on the type of unit conversion.
